subject: Windscreen chip turned into a crack
body:
Hello,

I'm writing in English as my Dutch is still a work in progress, I hope that's fine. On Thursday 29 October a lorry in front of me on the A28 threw up a stone and it left a chip in my windscreen. By the next morning it had spread into a crack right across the driver's side, so I had the windscreen replaced at Glasgarage Noord on 30 October. The invoice is attached.

Policy number: POL-100232, car H-210-BZ.

Kind regards,
Sanne Bakker
